'''Ibellia Ran's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Great Galactic War]]. She was a slave of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], who had a child with an [[Ibellia Ran's father|Imperial officer]]. Their daughter [[Ibellia Ran]] became a free citizen of the Empire.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ibellia Ran's mother is mentioned briefly in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on the [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']].
